Those statues...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Am I right in thinking they are[XENO:n ]
of High Entia origin?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

They are indeed.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]These are the Sororal Statues.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]They depict twin goddesses[XENO:n ]

who came of age were left here.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]If they survived, they could return[XENO:n ]
to the capital, triumphant.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Of course.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Fighting off the Satorl Guardian[XENO:n ]

[XENO:sel sel=・What an eccentric emperor/・An emperor of mixed blood? ][XENO:del del=this ]

in participating.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

simply being led to their death.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Entia was of mixed blood?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Yes.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]The ceremony must have been[XENO:n ]
needed to gain the people's trust.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Just as I faced the Tomb.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Does this place remind[XENO:n ]
you of the Tomb?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Yes. Of the hardship I faced there.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT1 ]And the friends that saved my life.[XENO:n ]

[XENO:line len=2 ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
